name: Felrend generates 1 Felfury even when it hits nothing (#7299)
contract: Felrend 563268 is a two-hand area swing (Effect0 NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG and Effect1 TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE,
both SRC_CASTER / SRC_AREA_ENEMY, 6 yd) whose tooltip reads 'Generates 1 Felfury' with no on-hit condition.
Live combat logs show every no-hit Felrend cast below the cap gaining Felfury 800058 within milliseconds.
With no creature anywhere near, the accepted cast must still add one Felfury stack.

steps.label: SETUP: no Felfury before the cast
Felrend with no enemy in range
DISCRIMINATING: the swing that hit nothing still grants 1 Felfury
